findings.title: Equality with coverage_xml still allows subset selectors; pin the exact full-suite argv, environment, timeout and parsers for all five pytest checks and pin pyproject testpaths
Validate contracts CI step is the only contract test run for non-bootstrap V0 PRs; keep it for non-bootstrap mode
recovery.md and pytest-temporary-roots.md become inaccurate and are outside allowed_scope
Policy change makes this task and other non-terminal tasks classification-stale; plan the policy_changed escalation, reclassification, design review and spec approval round
Shared run weakens failure attribution and changes --check semantics; document in quickstart
85% total coverage is not enforced by aiflow verify; run it manually; keep MUT-V2-001 detector test

summary: Collapsing unit_tests, regression_tests, acceptance and integration onto the coverage_xml command does merge into one execution with per-check results and complete V2 evidence (checked by in-memory plan simulation). Changes needed: pin the exact full-suite command, argv, environment, timeout and parsers for all five checks instead of 'equal to coverage_xml'; keep the contract CI step for non-bootstrap V0 runs; add recovery.md and pytest-temporary-roots.md to scope; plan the policy_changed reclassification round; update quickstart wording on shared runs and --check; refresh the workflow budget comment; note that 85% total coverage is enforced only by CI bootstrap and must be run manually.
